# Model promotion gate

<!-- Generated by `eval/model_gate.py --render-table` from eval/results/model_gate/*.json. Do not edit: D9 makes the result files the source of truth. -->

A model becomes the default only when all nine gates of D9 pass on both reference
machines, L (4c/8t AVX2 x86, 16 GB) and M (base Apple M-series, 16 GB), against the
pinned llama.cpp build (`xtask/llama.lock`). Any failure, and any gate that did not run,
keeps it `experimental`. The whole gate re-runs on every llama.cpp bump.

## Thresholds

| Key | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `model_gate.g2_generations` | 200 | binary |
| `model_gate.g3_fixtures` | 20 | binary |
| `model_gate.g4_max_seconds_on_l` | 50 | provisional |
| `llm.max_wallclock_share` | 0.25 | provisional |
| `model_gate.g5_max_repeat_ratio` | 0.4 | provisional |
| `model_gate.g6_max_rss_bytes` | 2684354560 | provisional |
| `model_gate.g6_release_seconds` | 2 | binary |
| `model_gate.g7_alpha` | 0.05 | provisional |
| `model_gate.g7_noninferiority_margin` | 0.02 | provisional |
| `model_gate.g8_min_probe_accuracy` | 0.95 | provisional |
| `model_gate.probe_items_per_language` | 100 | binary |

## Runs

No gate run is recorded yet. A run needs a reference machine, the pinned llama-server
and the model file; none of them was available where Phase 9 was built.
